label: Corporation Tax step change 2019–20
detail: HMRC Summary: CT gap broadly stable to 2018–19; step change in 2019–20 partly reflecting improvements in data collection. Emerging evidence that small-business CT gap may be understated before 2019–20 — not directly comparable to later years without Notes.

label: Illustrative behaviour series (Table 7.1)
detail: Table 7.1 starts at 2019–20. MTG 2023 methodological updates to behaviour assumptions do not extend the comparable series back to 2005–06. Do not splice older editions without Notes.

label: Two most recent years are projections
detail: Cover note / Summary: 2023–24 and 2024–25 are projections due to data lags (see Methodological annex). Curated status=provisional for those years.

label: Workbook notes on non-comparability
detail: Notes sheet flags components that are 'not directly comparable' across years (e.g. notes 30, 54, 55, 57 and related). Treat as vintage-specific; revisions each MTG edition rewrite prior years (note 1).

label: Gap ≠ fraud
detail: Evasion is only one illustrative behaviour (12% of the gap in 2024–25). Largest share is failure to take reasonable care (35%). Never label the whole gap as deliberate evasion.
